title: GET /v1/commerce/acme/lapsed?limit=<n>, a read key: the first issuances whose reservation ended unconfirmed after the computer had set a TXT, so that the budget keeps their slot for the whole window (an order may have been finalized and the CA may have issued a certificate nobody told the broker about). total counts all of them; entries are the ones at least policy.budget.lapsed_lift_after_s past the end of their reservation, which is the earliest a CT reconciliation may lift them (the CT logs need that long to show a certificate), oldest first, 100 at most. ended_at is when the reservation ran out.
